conditions: One macOS desktop run with normal Chrome, Slack, Claude and Codex activity; no other task-owned builds were active during qualification. Fixed fresh-then-daemon pairing; descriptive observations, not confidence intervals or causal attribution.

metadata.cold_policy: empty private endpoint; direct reference first may warm OS file cache
metadata.environment_policy: remove RUST_LOG and every case-insensitive MIMALLOC_ variable; explicit private RUE_DAEMON_ROOT and repository RUE_STD_PATH
metadata.image_policy: private read-only copies hashed before and after the run; hashes are external evidence and their cost is outside client clocks
metadata.rss_policy: ps RSS KiB at 100 ms after first reply identifies PID; cold-start peak unavailable; RSS includes allocator high-water memory
metadata.test_policy: real test execution, JSON events, seed 1, one test process; Rust projects verdicts/captures without event clocks
metadata.timing_boundary: monotonic_ns before Popen through communicate and child reap
metadata.worker_policy: build/analysis: four compiler workers; test: one test process and automatic compiler workers; resolved counts are in endpoint identity

summary.note: Descriptive observations on this host, without confidence intervals; ratios above one favor the daemon. RSS sampling misses initial startup and is distinct from live query charge.
